name: Crystal Drop
description: The Storm arrived and the rain drops rose into the skies as though returning to their mother's embrace and the blistering hot cauldron from which they came. But accidents might just happen. If they fail to reach the other side before the Storm ends, they will fall back to the earth.
descriptionVi: Cơn Bão ập đến, những giọt mưa bay ngược lên trời như trở về vòng tay mẹ, về lại chiếc nồi lửa cháy bỏng đã sinh ra chúng. Nhưng tai nạn vẫn có thể xảy ra. Nếu không kịp tới bờ bên kia trước khi Cơn Bão tan, chúng sẽ rơi trở lại mặt đất.
usage: A priceless arcanum currency. Can be used for summoning and item purchases.
usageVi: Summoning và item purchases.

name: Clear Drop
description: The quiet twin, the most reliable of the siblings, and the one always giving help to those in need. It is armed with every virtue. It is the last raindrop to rise, and the first to return to the earth.
descriptionVi: Người anh em song sinh trầm lặng, cũng là đứa đáng tin cậy nhất trong nhà, luôn sẵn lòng giúp đỡ những ai cần. Nó được trang bị đủ mọi đức tính tốt. Là giọt mưa cuối cùng bay lên, và là giọt đầu tiên trở về với đất.
usage: A priceless arcanum currency. Can be used for summoning or restoring Cellular Activity.
usageVi: Summoning hoặc restoring Cellular Activity.

name: Glowing Strand
description: Having crossed many storms, the most loyal spectator of the "Storm" now announces the end of an era. Its flash accompanies farewells, its fade heralds new beginnings.
usage: The bright flares of filaments mark the closing of one era and the opening of another, serving as one of the most valuable currencies in arcanum. Redeemable at [Miracle Mart] in the bank.

name: Lumined Instant
usage: Earned after any top-up. Accumulate enough to claim the corresponding tier reward at the Special Thanks Event.

name: Album of the Lost
description: The loudest and best Track of the Lost. This means more rock and roll and more soliloquies with barely changing moments of silence and white noise. Passionate fans will deliver the Track to its destination, but you must understand that they're not doing this pro bono.
descriptionVi: Bản Nhạc của Kẻ Lạc Lối to nhất và hay nhất. Nghĩa là nhiều rock and roll hơn, nhiều màn độc thoại hơn, với những khoảng lặng và tiếng ồn trắng gần như chẳng đổi thay. Những người hâm mộ cuồng nhiệt sẽ mang bản nhạc tới đích, nhưng phải hiểu rằng họ không làm việc này miễn phí.
usage: An album of tracks that have gone lost. Can be exchanged for items at the [Treble Counter] in the Bank.
usageVi: Can be exchanged for items at the [Treble Counter] in the Bank.

name: Thoughts in Entirety
description: As the disorganized has been organized, the darkened vision lightens, ideas are finally taking shape in my mind.
descriptionVi: Khi những điều hỗn độn đã được sắp xếp, tầm nhìn u tối dần sáng lên, và những ý tưởng cuối cùng cũng thành hình trong tâm trí ta.
usage: A complete arcanist's thoughts. Can be exchanged for items at the [Psychube Shop] in the Bank.
usageVi: Can be exchanged for items at the [Psychube Shop] in the Bank.

name: Penumbra Can
description: It contains one hundred milliliters of medicine, a square of foam floating next to a brown image, and one-third spoonful of time.
usage: A steel canister carrying medicine and memories. Can be used to unlock "Anecdotes".

name: Bundle of Light
description: Ideal tools for capturing tales, projecting them onto glass plates, lens caps, screens, or any other surface.
usage:
Moments frozen in time, etched onto a reel of light.
A token converted from the re-acquisition of certain items during rerun events. Can be exchanged at the [Fragment Shop] - [Nostalgia Shop].

name: Ticket Home
description: Once dried by the sun, later soaked by the rain, these crumpled tickets now lie in your pocket, silently waiting for you to return for a new journey?
usage: Back to tomorrow, back to the "Storm." Collect enough Tickets Home to claim rewards from the "Your Long-lost Friends" event.

name: Raw Component
description: Be sure to carefully polish the components until they shine brightly in the days ahead. Tomorrow is just around the corner, bringing with it a new beginning and limitless possibilities.
usage: A common industrial product. Used to rebuild factories.

name: Card of Fools
description: The age of Carbuncles is dawning. Perhaps its secret lies within these shifting cards.
usage: Come, let's see who the true "King of Fools" really is. Can be exchanged for rewards in Follies and Farces.

name: Blooming Tomorrow
description: It grows in the finest cracks of time and blossoms in the brightest hopes of friends.
usage: Can be used at the Parade Float Studio to decorate the parade float.

name: Building Blocks of Babel
description: People measure status by possessions. In this chatroom full of oddballs, vocabulary hoarding might just be a real thing.
usage: Words that flow through conversation, bricks that build the tower. Used to unlock additional titles and resources.

name: Wheat Seeds
description: It comes from the arcanist you know best for reading wind and seasons. Born in your Wilderness with its siblings, it carries the promise of more hope to come. It is plain. It is brilliant.
usage: Wheat seeds that Druvis III grew in the Wilderness. Used to sow once in "Moonlight Gardening."

name: Chaotic Data
description: "Who knows what we're supposed to do with these things? Seems like I need to gather all the 'semicolons' and 'decimal marks' together and wrap them up as a gift."
usage: Data generated during operation of the Huygens-Fresnel Interferometer. Can be exchanged for rewards at [Data Collection].

name: Metal Component
description: Worth recycling for the purity of its material. Commonly seen at Facility 3826.
usage: A common metal component. Collect them to exchange for rewards in Light Labor.

name: Whirring Winder
description: Twist the winder, stir up the sweetness ... what flavor will be next?
usage: A metal winder that emits a faint buzzing sound when turned. It makes the Cranking Gumball Machine in the wilderness dispense a Gumball.

name: Entwined Winder
description: They quarrel, competing for attention, and despite their protestations, are quite inseparable; yet they are also loving, passionate, and cooperative.
usage: A spiral-shaped winder that can mix two critter Gumballs in the Bumping Gumball Machine in the Wilderness.

name: Cellular Activity
description: When a candidate activates their arcane skill, the activity of this cell colony will significantly increase. The capacity for signal transduction gradually decreases over time. The candidate's control over arcane skill will also be significantly reduced.
usage: A cell colony unique to the arcanists. The cell activity supports the application of common arcanist skills.

name: Track of the Lost
description: Some people call it a tape, while more arcanists choose the name "Track of the Lost." It may have recorded a sad piece of rock music, an embarrassing monologue, a piece of white noise, or endless silence.
descriptionVi: Có người gọi nó là một cuộn băng, nhưng nhiều pháp sư hơn chọn cái tên "Bản Nhạc của Kẻ Lạc Lối". Trong đó có thể đã ghi lại một khúc rock buồn, một màn độc thoại đáng xấu hổ, một đoạn tiếng ồn trắng, hay sự im lặng vô tận.
sourceVi: Nhiệm vụ Triệu hồi - Hoạt động tuần
usage: A track that has gone lost. Can be exchanged for items at the [Bass Counter] in the Bank.
usageVi: Can be exchanged for items at the [Bass Counter] in the Bank.

name: Thought Element
description: There are so many ways to organize the mess: the furnace that burns, the blade that cuts ... but I wish to keep it the way it is.
descriptionVi: Có vô vàn cách để sắp xếp mớ hỗn độn: lò lửa thiêu rụi, lưỡi dao cắt lìa… nhưng ta muốn giữ nguyên nó như vậy.
usage: An element of arcanist's thoughts. Can be exchanged for items at the [Psychube Shop] in the Bank.
usageVi: Can be exchanged for items at the [Psychube Shop] in the Bank.

name: Oneiric Fluid
description: Snowflakes crushed by the wheels, pasture grass rustling in the wind, waves shattered against distant cliffs. Such sounds are insignificant but are recorded nonetheless. Again and again, till the very end.
descriptionVi: Những bông tuyết bị bánh xe nghiền nát, cỏ đồng nội xào xạc trong gió, sóng vỡ tan vào vách đá xa. Những âm thanh ấy chẳng đáng kể, nhưng vẫn được ghi lại. Lặp đi lặp lại, cho tới tận cùng.
usage: An insignificant dream meant to be forgotten. Can be exchanged for items in the [Oneiric Shop] in the Bank.
usageVi: Can be exchanged for items in the [Oneiric Shop] in the Bank.

name: Duty Certificate
description: More professional fieldwork earns a more professional certificate, awarded only to those who have yet to lie in a coffin.
usage: A special certificate issued to security personnel in partnership with Mane's Bank, redeemable at Mane's Vault.

name: Old Ticket
description: A worn ticket, perhaps it can take you back down memory lane.
usage: Can recall the fond memories of past journeys. Redeemable at [Rewards Revisited] in [Miracle Mart].

name: Primordial Pattern
description: The Minotaur in the labyrinth stole fire; melted wax wings tipped over Pandora's box. Thus history collapsed into the future, and we continue falling with our arms outstretched—searching and searching for an exit that may not exist.
usage: A tiny, shimmering page inscribed with a record, real and eternal. Can be exchanged at the Brainwave Shop.

name: Puppy Coin
description: "Thank you for endorsing the newspaper industry." This commemorative coin is prepared for the readers who completed all the issues here. It's exquisitely made; you can keep it as a souvenir, or trade it for some interesting little things.
usage:
Exchange items at "Rimet Cup" souvenir shop with it.
Only available during the event "The Theft of the Rimet Cup".

name: Reading Chance
description: A clever reader knows when to pause. We are deeply encouraged if you had a good time reading the magazine; but it's always good to take a small break from it.
usage:
A friendly reminder on the title page of FLASH:FAME which shows how many chances you have left to challenge yourself in UTTU Retails.
"UTTU Flash Gathering" only.
5 chances will be given at 5am each day.

name: UTTU Voucher
description: You earn it through hard work. The reward always comes with knowledge, insights, and patience.
usage: A voucher issued by UTTU Magazine. Can be exchanged for items at the [UTTU Shop]. Can only be used during the [UTTU Flash Gathering: Trophy of the Past Glory] event.

name: Canned Scream
description: A camping essential packed with nutrients. Free from Arcanum additives, promise. Your tongue trembles sometimes when you chew it? You're just imagining things.
usage: Indispensable survival provision. Exchange at the Treeshed Counter for a reward.

name: Dry Wood
description: Dry, compact wood. This gift from the forest is lightweight, sturdy, and easy to work with. Take care when removing the tangled mycelium, and don't stare at the growth rings for too long.
usage: Consumables gathered from all over. Used to repair all sorts of Green Lake campsite equipment.

name: Eternal Astrolabe
description: At long last, each arc overlaps to form a plane and arrive at an answer. So much time has passed that it no longer matters.
usage:
An astrolabe that rotates forever on its own axis. Can be used in exchange for the Gift Shop of Kubera.
Can only be used during the [Journey to Mor Pankh] event.

name: That Which Glitters
description: It may be a gift from the heavens, or the pursuit of fortune hunters. "Hark, a gift of intelligence from above!"
usage:
A crystal that encases a dazzling light. Can be used to harken Whispers of the Sky.
Can only be used during the [Journey to Mor Pankh] event. Cannot be obtained after all whispers have been harkened to.

name: Eureka
description: No one has ever been able to explain its origin and destination. Born from subtleties and vanishing between thoughts, like a fleeting halo in dense foam.
usage:
An Afflatus fragment made of a unique material. Can help 37 with making conjectures in [Black Box of Conjectures].
Usable only during the [The Prisoner in the Cave] event.

name: APPLe Coin
description: The reconstruction of APPLe II is quite an undertaking that encompasses various aspects. As such, Regulus has minted this currency to quantify the rebuilding process—how useful it is is a matter of opinion.
usage:
A copper-plated coin with Mr. APPLe's portrait, used for repairing APPLe II.
Usable only during the "Set Sail Again" event.

name: Dusty Document
description: These accumulated documents, as old and useless as the dust piled upon them, are somewhat interesting as a bit of light reading before dinner.
usage: Neglected documents in the corner of a filing cabinet. Used to unlock sealed records.

name: Ancient Flame
description: This dark stone witnessed the birth of the first flame and the tremors of the primal earth. It now awaits a new owner. It waits for a burning heart.
usage:
Obsidian scarred with scorch marks. Can be exchanged at Red Soil Cave.
Can only be used during the [Revival! The Uluru Games] event.

name: Eucalyptus Pod
description: Eucalyptus tree pods are said to contain blessings that keep travelers safe as they roam the land. Take them with you to your destination—these eucalyptus seeds will take root in that distant land and multiply, lasting forever as this friendship shall, too.
usage:
The seed pods of an Australian tree often used to express respect and friendship toward guests. Can be used to establish relationships.
Can only be used during the [Revival! The Uluru Games] event. Form a relationship to receive the blessings of the Fire Totem.

name: Spark Seal
description:
The sparks remain silent, congregate, then form a fledgling flame, igniting the vast earth.
Under the night sky, every spark shines like a star. It is in this spirit that we maintain the utmost respect to each and every responsible volunteer at the games.
usage: The official volunteer seal for the Uluru Games. Complete commissions to obtain. Can be exchanged for rewards.

name: Paper Horse
description: Often cut into the shapes of the Gods of Sheti and posted on porches and windows, they are commonly used to ward off evil spirits.
usage: Paper horse for praying and blessing, they play an important role in Prayers.

name: Goldfinch Coin
description: Soft metal birds with a white bread taste. Besides being used for navigation and currency, they can also be grilled for sustenance when needed.
usage: An arcanum currency popular with travelers. Needs to be fed regularly with breadcrumbs in case it gets lost. Used to exchange goods in the Strange Stall.

name: Comradery
description: Carrying the torch forward, it comes from the clasped hands and shoulders of companions. It is both the light and the kindling.
usage: A unique power. Used to increase your team's Willpower.

name: Lucky Coin
description: It scatters in the spring, bringing joy and protection. In the pages of books, between the layers of steamers... only children know the patterns it hides.
usage: Currency from the ancient East. Can be used to purchase special items in certain shops.

name: "Symphony"
description: Everyone knows this concoction. With its rich and delightful aroma, it can transform the ordinary into the extraordinary, invigorate the drowsy, and add a touch of sparkle to the truly gifted. But its greatest virtue may also be its only flaw—it is everywhere.
usage: Fruit preserved in a jar, ready to be broken down by the power of words. Can be traded at designated counters.

name: UTTU Points
description: A vivid portrayal of the phrase "a penny saved is a penny earned." Let's see what they can really do ... How many points can you get?
usage: A custom UTTU points card obtained by salvaging existing FAME Cards. Can also be exchanged for new FAME Cards.

name: Cornerstone
description: After passing through countless hands, we have finally brought it here. This powerful substance can melt even the coldest steel and awaken the permafrost. It brings life to this place and fulfills the promised utopia of the torrent.
usage: A burning heart made of black diamonds, sweat, and the rushing Red River. Can be traded at designated counters.

name: Black Diamond
description: Thus, it sustains an entire town, bringing a sparkle to every pair of eager eyes that gaze upon its fiery glow.
usage: Long-buried minerals used to process Raw Components at the factory.

name: Daily Meal
description: Sugar, salt, vitamins, and protein—a safe and nutritious choice for when there's no time to dine. [DISCLAIMER] Any nausea experienced after consumption is due purely to the taste and is unrelated to the inclusion of any undisclosed ingredients.
usage:
A special meal developed by Laplace. One serving satisfies a full day's nutritional needs.
Can be exchanged for rewards at the Vending Machines.
Can only be used during the [Vereinsamt] event.

name: Fluid Medal
description: The gleam of cold steel, the smoke of war, and the fierce throbbing of a beating heart. Memories of victory will be commemorated, achievements magnified, setbacks transformed into stepping stones.
usage:
Contains memories of intense battles. A substance required to unlock Final Replay.
Can only be used during the [Vereinsamt] event.

name: Spiritual Crystal Cluster
description: Condensed from pure energy, derived from wind, minerals, and the Mother Earth. It knows and accepts everything, it gives and guides the way back.
usage: The most popular healing product at the New Age Market, powerful enough to purify all negative energy. Can be exchanged at special counters. Only available during the [Floor it! To the Golden City] event period.

name: "Old Key"
description: You already know these old tales all too well, my dear. Pick up the key and place it where it belongs, jingling amongst its siblings in your hand. But remember, holding the key is just the beginning. The true question is ... what will it unlock?
usage:
These old keys can be found almost everywhere—by roadsides, under blankets, or even in sewers. Can be traded at special counters.
Only available during the [Route 77: The Haunted Highway] event.

name: Spare Scrap
description: Turning scrap into gems is actually quite simple—all you need are three things: a discerning eye, nimble hands, and a sense of nostalgia.
usage: One man's trash is another man's treasure. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Jigjog Coin
description: Shiny trinkets always make the Carbuncles jump higher, even the most well-mannered gentlemen are no exception.
usage: A highly valuable trinket. Issued by Ms. NewBabel's Critter Rehabilitation Center, this exclusive currency is used to purchase all kinds of critter-related items.

name: Intel Key
description: Like silk threads of thought swaying in the windless night, capturing the light.
usage:
Used to decode intelligence in [Moth Code].
Can only be used during the [Phototaxis in Study: Mask On] event.

name: Paper Medallion
description: Simple and lightweight, its creases far from perfect, yet you wear it proudly on your collar until the festival—held by you and your neighbors—comes to an end.
usage: A handmade memento. Can be traded at special counters.

name: Puppet Heart
description: Congratulations for winning a puppet's heart, even if it was not through love ...
usage: Proof of defeating puppets. Can be exchanged at the Heart Salvage for rewards. Can retain up to 6000.

name: Seagull's Call
description: A low-level alchemical product, easy to make during long voyages—just some paper, a bit of ink, a day's worth of longing for home, a pinch of seasickness, a sound collection spell, and a noisy seagull.
usage: Souvenir cards sold to passengers. Opening them triggers the sound of seagulls. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Gossip Note
description:
"Did you hear about the guy from the theater and that one from the restaurant? They're making waves these days …"

—The findings of a private detective who wore out three pairs of shoes.
usage: Afternoon gossip from old uncles and aunties in the alleys, secrets even academics could never find. Redeemable at the special counter.

name: Wealth Indicator
description: Now roll the die to determine how much wealth you have ... Five. Take this coin—it represents five wealth. Units? There are no units.
usage: A symbol of value in civilized society, now only used for tracking changes in numbers. Can be exchanged at a special counter.

name: Cosmic Shard
description: Distant star clusters search for eyes to gaze at them. In the void of nothingness, people recognize a familiar halo—and at the end of the eternal river, the Cassiopeia Nebula finally alights.
usage: A letter sent from the boundless to a small planet, kept as proof that "the faraway" truly exists. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Cryoamber
description: It came from the depths, molten, folded, compressed, sunk beneath waves, then rising to the surface. Yet there will always be those who decipher within it secrets of the last ice age, or epochs more ancient still.
usage:
A specimen chiseled from polar ice-rock, awaiting deeper study. Can be exchanged for rewards at "Delivery on Ice."
Can only be used during the [Paradise Regained] event.

name: "Good Idea"
usage: Can be used during the "A Pirate's Guide to Lab Disasters" event to attain "Borrowed" Keys. During the event, every 30 Activity consumed grants 1 "Good Idea."

name: "Borrowed" Key
usage: Can be used during the "A Pirate's Guide to Lab Disasters" event to claim rewards.

name: Depleted Ammunition
description: Empty bullet casings find new purpose as lighters, pen holders, and cigarette containers ... What gives birth to trench art is never the weapons left behind, but rather the human spirit that refuses to stop creating.
usage: Relics of war that lie abandoned on the ground, growing cold as they fade from memory. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Ironheart of the Danube
description: The whistle sounds, shadows stir, and the piper plays a soft tune. A farewell gift for the homeless.
usage: A special keepsake from the "Danube Dawn," designed with the conductress's input and gifted to travelers who found peace through the long night. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Fluffy Furry Favorite
description: Those who wander the Wilderness are all curious about the "well." The Spring Elfin pour clear water, Wonderland's maidens gift it syrup, and it answers with shifting colors. Fuzzy little things swim within it, leaping out bearing the well's blessings, like burrs clinging to a dog's fur. Just offer them a fine meal as a treat after their little adventure.
usage: A snack tin worthy of being called bait, filled with Dust, Crisp Twigs, and Wonder Bubbles. The perfect reward after an adventure in the Dreamwell. Used to encourage Critter staff to complete a salvage mission there.

name: Shard of Prophecy
description: A handful of shattered smoky crystals reflecting a myriad of unfortunate futures. The charm of fate lies in its murkiness.
usage: A flawed product from the workshop. It might fool amateurs, but it's nowhere near Bouanich's standard. Can be exchanged at the Special Counter.

name: Wartime Currency
description: The most valuable things in your pack: biscuits, cheese, canned beef. You learned their worth in the tall grass, bomb craters, muddy ground—and when dealing with fellows just as wretched as you. Remember: keep them safe, tucked tightly in your pocket.
usage: The only valid "currency" during wartime—and perhaps your most reliable friend. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Windborne Whisper
description: "There aloft, the bird saw the moving white mists of spring, the dust clouds, and the living things each blowing their breaths among them." —Reed excerpts this passage in her interpretation of Qi.
usage: An omnipresent yet intangible current. Only those blessed can catch the messages within. Can be traded at special counters.

name: Marvelous Marble
description: Every piece of glass dreams of becoming a marble like this—vibrant, joyful, and full of energy. Oh, watch your box! These restless little things are always trying to leap out and crash a bigger party.
usage: Colorful marbles that never stop bouncing—fast favorites at any party. Can be exchanged at Musae's Store (up to 17,420).

name: Mural Fragment
description: Step into the walls and plaster—into a journey of the heart from the Americas.
usage: The secret to endless creativity hides in the everyday seams of plaster. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Pre-Storm Protocol Drafts
description: Every line requires careful consideration, and every detail must be handled with care.
usage: Thanks to Enigma and the others, the drafts for the Pre-Storm Protocol have filled up an entire room. Can be exchanged at special counters (no more can be obtained after reaching the limit).

name: Deductive Step
description: Not every puzzle can be solved immediately, but our work today may serve as the foundation for future deductions.
usage: Observations, experiments, and records—the traces left by those who walked this path before us. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Strata Calibrator
description: How do we brush the dust from her face? We have only crawled as far as her eyelashes. How do we restore her true silhouette? We have only uncovered a fragment of the radiance.
usage: A tool for measuring strata and faith. Can be exchanged in Chronicle Excerpts.

name: Promise Note
description: The folds and smudged ink on this old note take nothing away from the promises it carries, nor from the sincerity behind every word of gratitude. Put it to good use before the rain falls.
usage: A promissory note issued by the Arcane Item Vault. Once used by Loggerhead as a memo for warehouse inventory, it now serves as a record of borrowers' promises. Can be exchanged in the Arcane Item Vault.

name: Plumb Line
description: It bears witness to every brick and tile, standing unshaken. From a single brick to a wall, from a building to a city—it falls forever upright and vertical.
usage: Ancient tool whose wisdom helps to keep a building truly vertical. What it holds steady is the precision of the architecture itself. Can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Dragon Boat Support Voucher
description: The Critters are putting their pride (and some pebble candies) on the line! Time to cheer on your favorite team!
usage: Can be used in "Fluffs, Shells, and Waves!" to support your favorite team.

name: Florin
description:
From street doctors to the Castel Sant'Angelo's elite, nobody refuses the glint of a florin. You already know how to acquire them. As for spending them, your assassin friend may have some practical advice.
"Monteriggioni appreciates your generosity."
usage: Minted in Florence, these coins circulated throughout the Italian peninsula during the Renaissance. They can be exchanged at special counters.

name: Neuropolymer
description: Stones, axes, guns, and electric gear, each weapon has its own skill tree. Those trees bear a single fruit named "THOUGHT."
usage: A programmable liquid substance, widely used for machines and robots. Can be used to unlock skills for the glove.

name: Neuromed Capsule
description: Yes, scientific development is gaining momentum and the future beckons, but don't forget to heal the wounds of the past.
usage: A capsule that recovers health, a must-have at Facility 3826. Can be exchanged for rewards at the Repair Station.

name: Jigjog Candy
description: When the reward is tempting enough, no training is too difficult to grasp.
usage: Popping candy wrapped in shiny paper, rich in dust beloved by critters. Used to train critters and improve their stats.

name: Queen Piece
description: How many queens can stand on a chessboard? Hush. The rules of play are a bit looser in Wonderland.
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Rat Knight
description: A nimble, squeaky, and occasionally rusty little creature that clings to the thick fur of Carbuncles and climbs out of the well with them.
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Laughter Pepper
description: Elfin water mixed with "Wonderland" syrup ... with a dose of it the cracked soil of the Wilderness begins to yield gifts. According to Baby Blue, this pepper is a prized treat during Wonderland teatimes ... or at least, her grinning friend seems to think so.
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Superview Shroom
description: A bright, peculiar mushroom unlike any known species. Ezra advises against eating it, though he's quite intrigued by Baby Blue's claim that it can "broaden one's horizons."
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Sharpodonty
description: A currency from the ancient, unrecorded era. It has 13 edges and a maw of razor sharp teeth which only opens to those with arcanist blood.
descriptionVi: Một loại tiền tệ từ thời đại cổ xưa, không còn được ghi chép. Nó có 13 cạnh và một cái miệng đầy răng sắc như dao cạo, chỉ mở ra với những kẻ mang dòng máu pháp sư.
sourceVi: Tài nguyên - Tiệm Cầm đồ Mintage Aesthetics
usage: An acceptable currency amongst the arcanists. Everyone needs some of this.
usageVi: Everyone needs some of this.

name: Dust
description: The glorious supreme law is nowhere to be found, but its power is great and beyond prediction. As it wanders, its dropping Dust also contains the energy for power increasing. It is, in a sense, part of the ultimate answer.
descriptionVi: Đạo luật tối thượng huy hoàng đã chẳng còn tìm thấy ở đâu, nhưng sức mạnh của nó vẫn lớn lao và khôn lường. Trong lúc lang thang, những hạt Bụi nó rơi xuống cũng chứa năng lượng để gia tăng sức mạnh. Theo một nghĩa nào đó, đó là một phần của đáp án tối hậu.
sourceVi: Tài nguyên - Tiệm Cầm đồ Poussiere
usage: Echoes of the ultra law. Can be used for leveling up characters.
usageVi: Leveling up characters.

name: Wilderness Shell
description: A colorful, shiny shell placed in a chest. Coveted by many, it is usually covered with silk, and sometimes shroud.
usage: A shell left in the Wilderness. Can be exchanged for items at the [Wilderness Shop] in the Bank.

name: Pawn Piece
description: Every soldier longs to transcend their station. On a 64-square board, they march without rest.
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Dodough Dreamdust
description: Just one teaspoon buys you a pale-blue dream. Ms. NewBabel's Critter Rehab Center guarantees: no riddles, no crowns, no axes.
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Teardrop Orb
description:
It's well known that the birth of the "Dreamwell" was partly due to La Source's prank. But ...
"This isn't my spring—it could never be this salty!" cried the startled Elfin.
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Roundabout Signpost
description: Points everywhere and nowhere, seemingly from "Wonderland." Crunchy, Dust-rich, and beloved by Carbuncles that gnaw on them during their Dreamwell frolics.
usage: Findings salvaged from the Dreamwell can be traded for various items in "Fluffy Exchange."

name: Harmonic Conch
description: How do you listen to a story that's almost silent? Do you press your ear to the curtain or let her tuning fork rest against your skull?
usage: If you've ever tried to hear those faint voices. Can be exchanged for rewards at the Cradle of Harmony.

name: Fruit of Good and Evil
description: It is the rebel vanguard for the disobedient and those who seek knowledge.
descriptionVi: Nó là đội tiên phong nổi loạn của những kẻ bất tuân và những ai tìm cầu tri thức.
usage: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Mistilteinn
description: It is the edge for the weak, the silent, and the belittled.
descriptionVi: Nó là lưỡi dao dành cho kẻ yếu, kẻ im lặng và kẻ bị coi thường.
usage: It never swore an oath. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Golden Fleece
description: It is a reward for the adventurous and the bravest souls.
descriptionVi: Nó là phần thưởng cho những tâm hồn ưa phiêu lưu và dũng cảm nhất.
usage: Thousands died in the sea seeking it. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Serpent Scepter
description: Mediating peace between those in dispute and hostility.
descriptionVi: Dàn xếp hòa bình giữa những kẻ tranh chấp và thù địch.
usage: The oar of the River of Dreams that once hypnotized a giant. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Rheingold
description: The forger cursed it, thus the bearer regretted it.
descriptionVi: Kẻ rèn ra nó đã nguyền rủa nó, và người mang nó phải hối hận.
usage: Another ancient testament to humanity's destructive tendencies. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters.

name: Walking Terror
description: It jumps. It walks. But never crows. Faithfully reconstructed from survivor testimony.
descriptionVi: Nó nhảy. Nó bước đi. Nhưng không bao giờ gáy. Được tái tạo trung thực từ lời khai của những người sống sót.
usage: A miniature replica of the infamous Baba Yaga's House. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters.

name: Bogeyman
description: Your children are right about the Bogeyman. As a parent, you better keep an eye out for these wicked kidnappers. But they can be lucrative. Catch one and it might help pay the bills because we're buying them! Call 098-1937**21 for details.
descriptionVi: Bọn trẻ nhà ngươi nói đúng về Ông Kẹ. Là bậc cha mẹ, tốt nhất hãy để mắt tới lũ bắt cóc độc ác này. Nhưng chúng có thể mang lại lợi nhuận. Bắt được một con, ngươi có thể có tiền trả hóa đơn, vì bọn ta đang thu mua chúng! Gọi 098-1937**21 để biết chi tiết.
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ
usage: "Monster ... MOM! HELP! THERE'S A MONSTER UNDER MY BED!" Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Incorrupt Monkeypaw
description: A dried arm of a primate. Don't wish for anything from it, and that includes silent wishes as well.
descriptionVi: Một cánh tay khô của loài linh trưởng. Đừng ước bất cứ điều gì từ nó, kể cả những lời ước thầm kín.
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ
usage: An extremely rare material from Harappa. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Wyrmling Skeleton
description: Dragons, the true cryptid. A living dragon commands majestic power, while a dead one is still a trove of riches.
descriptionVi: Rồng — sinh vật huyền bí đích thực. Một con rồng còn sống nắm giữ sức mạnh uy nghi, còn một con đã chết vẫn là cả một kho báu.
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ
usage: Skeleton of the dragon. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Silver Bullet
description: It takes effort to make one, but it's definitely worth it. No matter if your target is a vampire or a werewolf, it will come in handy.
descriptionVi: Chế tạo một viên tốn không ít công sức, nhưng hoàn toàn đáng giá. Dù mục tiêu của ngươi là ma cà rồng hay người sói, nó cũng sẽ có ích.
source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ, Cốt truyện
usage: Patterned silver bullets that contain immense power. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Murmur of Insanity
description: You will get to read the most hidden, forbidden and forgotten spells in history among the mad words of this book. He is the best tutor for all the ambitious villains. Just remember one thing: ask only, and never answer.
descriptionVi: Giữa những lời điên loạn trong cuốn sách này, ngươi sẽ đọc được những câu chú bí ẩn nhất, bị cấm đoán nhất và đã bị lãng quên nhất trong lịch sử. Nó là người thầy giỏi nhất cho mọi kẻ phản diện đầy tham vọng. Chỉ cần nhớ một điều: hãy chỉ hỏi, và đừng bao giờ trả lời.
source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ, Cốt truyện
usage: The most dangerous and hazardous book to the best of your knowledge. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Glowing Mothwing
description: Please do not stimulate the light source at its tail. Handle gently to avoid burning.
descriptionVi: Xin đừng kích thích nguồn sáng ở đuôi nó. Hãy cầm nhẹ nhàng để tránh bị bỏng.
usage: A moth that's noticed the faint light within itself. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Watch Core
description: Through polishing, inlaying, and fine carving, one can obtain a lively "heart."
descriptionVi: Qua mài giũa, khảm nạm và chạm khắc tinh xảo, người ta có thể có được một "trái tim" sống động.
usage: The word "Precision" is inscribed inside. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Goldbell Spirit Bottle
description: Rumored to be vessels sealing mysterious living spirits. Each one is treasured and priceless beyond compare—though the owner is evasive and deeply secretive about their origins.
descriptionVi: Tương truyền đây là những chiếc bình phong ấn các linh thể sống bí ẩn. Mỗi chiếc đều được trân quý và vô giá không gì sánh bằng — dù chủ nhân của chúng luôn lảng tránh và cực kỳ giữ kín về nguồn gốc.
usage: Made with a spirit, to be planted in a body. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Emerald Slate
description: "Separate the earth from the fire, refine the essence from the rough, proceed with caution."
descriptionVi: "Tách đất khỏi lửa, luyện tinh chất từ thứ thô ráp, hãy tiến hành thật cẩn trọng."
usage: Each inscription on it holds profound wisdom. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Platinum Ouija
description: It shall purge things that lead you astray.
descriptionVi: Nó sẽ thanh tẩy những thứ dẫn ngươi đi lạc lối.
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ

usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Golden Compass
description: It will remove the wrong paths for you.

usage: A weathered compass. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Rhizobox Rabbit
description: An isolated island. A century-old tree. The perfect place to preserve insignificant souls across the ages.
descriptionVi: Một hòn đảo biệt lập. Một cái cây trăm tuổi. Nơi hoàn hảo để gìn giữ những linh hồn nhỏ bé qua bao thế kỷ.
usage: A treasure-hiding ritual, a favorite among traditionalists. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Tome of Mineral Wealth
description: A titan's child that emerged from a weeping wound of the Earth vein. It is a steadfast guardian and an indestructible friend. Even the nobles would bow before this sonorous herald.
descriptionVi: Nó là một người bảo vệ kiên định và một người bạn không thể phá hủy. Ngay cả giới quý tộc cũng phải cúi đầu trước sứ giả vang dội này.
usage: A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Mineral Insight III.
usageVi: The ritual of Mineral Insight III.

name: Tome of Starlit Ascent
description: An omen, a filthy secret, or an act of absolute vileness. You can also treat it as a handful of broken glass on black satin.
descriptionVi: Một điềm báo, một bí mật bẩn thỉu, hay một hành vi hoàn toàn đê tiện. Ngươi cũng có thể xem nó như một nắm thủy tinh vỡ trên tấm lụa đen.
usage: A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Star Insight III.
usageVi: The ritual of Star Insight III.

name: Tome of Plantal Vimen
description: It is the source of every twig in the deep woods, every strand of moss and floating weed and the mother of every tree. All of them know you.
descriptionVi: Nó là nguồn gốc của mọi cành nhỏ trong rừng sâu, mọi sợi rêu và đám rong trôi nổi, và là mẹ của muôn loài cây. Tất cả bọn chúng đều biết ngươi.
usage: A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Plant Insight Ⅲ.
usageVi: The ritual of Plant Insight III.

name: Tome of Beastly Thirst
description: Their every breath feels like that of their mother's mother and their father's father. They see what the mortals see.
descriptionVi: Mỗi hơi thở của chúng đều giống như hơi thở của bà nội bên ngoại và ông nội bên nội chúng. Chúng nhìn thấy những gì phàm nhân nhìn thấy.
usage: A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Beast Insight III.
usageVi: The ritual of Beast Insight III.

name: Biting Box
description: You won't be able to tell where it comes from, whom it belongs to or why it looks so strange. More importantly, you will never know what you have released.
descriptionVi: Bạn sẽ không thể biết nó đến từ đâu, thuộc về ai hay vì sao nó trông kỳ lạ đến vậy. Quan trọng hơn, bạn sẽ mãi mãi không biết mình vừa giải phóng thứ gì.
source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ, Cốt truyện
usage: A strange, heavy box. People claim to have heard strange noises from it. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Salted Mandrake
description: A mandrake that does not scream? That must be the greatest thing in the history of Arcanum! Robert the Magnesia made a fortune with this and now lives in his very own manor.
descriptionVi: Một củ mandrake không gào thét? Đó hẳn phải là phát minh vĩ đại nhất trong lịch sử Arcanum! Robert the Magnesia đã phát tài nhờ thứ này và giờ sống trong dinh thự của riêng mình.
source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ, Cốt truyện

usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Bifurcated Skeleton
description: What did the humans say again? Oh, what a poor, deformed little thing! But guess what the arcanists say. Oh my, look at these sublime features only evident in the noblest of all blood lines!
descriptionVi: Người ta nói gì nhỉ? Ôi, một sinh linh nhỏ bé tội nghiệp và dị dạng làm sao! Nhưng thử đoán xem các pháp sư nói gì. Ôi chao, hãy nhìn những đường nét siêu phàm chỉ xuất hiện ở dòng máu cao quý nhất!
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ
usage: A skeleton with 2 skulls. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

description: Everybody loves a pretty bullion of silver. Being washed in holy water not only gave them a beauteous sheen, but also powerful arcane energy and exorcist properties.

source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ, Cốt truyện

usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

description: An arcanist's best friend! Let this little birdie remember your spells for you. With over 5241 practical spells in its memory bank, this is the go-to choice for busy arcanists!
descriptionVi: Người bạn thân thiết nhất của mọi nhà thuật pháp! Hãy để chú chim nhỏ này ghi nhớ phép thuật thay bạn. Với hơn 5241 thần chú thực dụng được lưu trong bộ nhớ, đây chính là lựa chọn hàng đầu cho những nhà thuật pháp bận rộn!
source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ, Cốt truyện

usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Winged Key
description: Find an open space, hold the key handle firmly, and mentally recite your destination. It will lead you to the keyhole, in the form of a bird.
descriptionVi: Hãy tìm một khoảng trống, nắm chắc phần chuôi chìa khóa và niệm đích đến trong tâm trí. Nó sẽ dẫn bạn tới ổ khóa dưới hình dạng một chú chim.
usage: Not every key is born with wings. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

usage: A component shaped like an elegant goose neck. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Golden Grass Incense

usage: Crafted with indiscernible materials and blended from a secret formula, this incense is often used to nourish the heart. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.

description: A ticket for the rising and setting of the sun. A guiding lantern between this shore and the other.

name: Clawed Pendulum
description: It shall lead your way.
descriptionVi: Nó sẽ dẫn lối cho bạn.
source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story

usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Golden Beetle
description: They discern directions through the moisture of the soil and the change of light, looking forward to their moment of maturation.
descriptionVi: Chúng nhận biết phương hướng qua độ ẩm của đất và sự thay đổi của ánh sáng, mong chờ khoảnh khắc mình trưởng thành.
usage: The shell of a beetle turned into a beautiful pendant. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters.

name: Jeweled Egg
description: Legend has it that sealing one's heart inside the egg grants immortality—perhaps the world's earliest attempt at heart transplant preservation.
descriptionVi: Truyền thuyết kể rằng phong ấn trái tim mình vào trong quả trứng sẽ ban tặng sự bất tử — có lẽ đây là nỗ lực bảo tồn trái tim để cấy ghép sớm nhất trên thế giới.
usage: An intricate jeweled egg that seems to be a part of a nesting-doll set. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Scroll of Mineral Wealth
description: The rock spits on those with a weak mind. It is the code between instant and eternity.
descriptionVi: Đá khinh bỉ những kẻ có tâm trí yếu ớt. Nó là mật mã giữa khoảnh khắc và vĩnh cửu.
usage: Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Mineral Insight II.
usageVi: The ritual of Mineral Insight II.

name: Scroll of Starlit Ascent
description: It breeds infants and helps them sleep in peace. It is a friend of lengthy nights and fantasies.
descriptionVi: Nó nuôi dưỡng những đứa trẻ và giúp chúng ngủ yên. Nó là bạn của những đêm dài và những giấc mộng viển vông.
usage: Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Star Insight II.
usageVi: The ritual of Star Insight II.

name: Scroll of Plantal Vimen
description: It shall keep growing till it smothers the entire sky, till it chokes every single space, till the deep green tide blankets everything in sight.
descriptionVi: Nó sẽ tiếp tục lớn lên cho tới khi che kín cả bầu trời, cho tới khi bóp nghẹt từng khoảng không, cho tới khi thủy triều xanh thẳm phủ kín mọi thứ trong tầm mắt.
usage: Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Plant Insight Ⅱ.
usageVi: The ritual of Plant Insight II.

name: Scroll of Beastly Thirst
description: They walked in the barrens, resting in the day and rising in the night.
descriptionVi: Chúng bước đi trên những vùng đất hoang, nghỉ ngơi ban ngày và thức dậy ban đêm.
usage: Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Beast Insight II.
usageVi: The ritual of Beast Insight II.

name: Liquefied Terror
description: You trembled in your dreams and suddenly woke up with a scream. They were running across your skin. Made with cracked teeth, the liquefaction has improved its stability and shelf life. Tasting it is not recommended as it brings more than just nightmares.
descriptionVi: Bạn run rẩy trong giấc mơ và bỗng bật dậy với một tiếng thét. Chúng đang bò khắp da bạn. Được chế từ những chiếc răng nứt, quá trình hóa lỏng đã cải thiện độ ổn định và hạn sử dụng của nó. Không nên nếm thử, vì thứ nó mang lại không chỉ là ác mộng.
source: Craft in the Wilderness, Pawnshop, Story
sourceVi: Chế tạo trong Hoang dã, Tiệm Cầm đồ, Cốt truyện

usageVi: Insight hoặc Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

name: Milled Magnesia
description: Usable in exorcism and purification rites. It may not be important, but we can't do without it.

usage: A coupon for speedy decoration services from the Miracle Mart, allowing you to buy [Miracle Mart]'s [Suitcase Settings] items at half price. This item expires on May 29, 2025, at 5:00. If you already have all Suitcase Settings purchased from the Miracle Mart at the time of expiry, this item will be converted to 990 Clear Drops.

name: Miracle Coupon
description: Tired of seeing the same dull suitcase interior? It's time to let the Miracle Mart bring the magic! Trust in Miracle Mart, to deliver you the best!
usage: A coupon for speedy decoration services from the Miracle Mart, allowing you to buy some of the items in [Miracle Mart] at half price. This item will expire on May 28, 2026, at 05:00 (UTC+8). If, upon expiration, there are no items available for purchase from the Miracle Mart - New Wonders, this item will automatically convert into 1640 Clear Drops after expiring.

name: Cocoon of Myths
description: Dreams that slip through your fingers, fleeting sparks of inspiration that make you laugh, make you sigh, and forever tempt you to drown in a sea of endless possibility.
usage: Tangled and gleaming flashes of thought, and the once-lost inspiration that made your fingertips tremble with excitement. Use this to awaken a chosen Epiphany and instantly raise a character's Euphoria or Lucidity to maximum.

name: Encased Nominations
categoryVi: Tự chọn 6 sao trong phạm vi
description: A curated list prepared for the Timekeeper, perfect for long journeys. Wipe away the moisture and take a look—these are your trusted companions.
usage: A cloudy album tucked inside a suitcase. Open it to choose one designated 6-Star character from a selection pool to visit. More characters join the pool as you progress through the main story.

name: Delicate Vision Blocks
categoryVi: Đổi công trình Hoang dã (ngừng dùng)
description:
The treasured heirloom of an arcanist family with the passion of creation.
Blessed with such power, it holds infinite potential—able to take shape as anything that comes to your mind.
usage: A pile of building blocks that has been passed down through generations with undefined form. Can be exchanged for off-sale Orange-quality and lower-tier Buildings or Archipelago in [Vision of Tomorrow].

name: Fine Vision Blocks
categoryVi: Đổi công trình Hoang dã (ngừng dùng)
description: The priceless blocks popular in arcanists with self-assemble components. Not only is it ideal for constructing masterpieces, but also perfect for filling in missing pieces.
usage: A pile of building blocks that with unknown origin, yearning to be a part of some magnificent designs. Can be exchanged for off-sale Yellow-quality and lower-tier Buildings or Archipelago in [Vision of Tomorrow].

name: Simple Vision Blocks
categoryVi: Đổi công trình Hoang dã (ngừng dùng)
description: Once a beloved toy, now a forgotten set of dusty blocks. With just a bit of patience and creativity, they can bring different scenes to life.
usage: A pile of building blocks that carries childhood memories to build the fundamental visions. Can be exchanged for off-sale Purple-quality and lower-tier Buildings or Archipelago in [Vision of Tomorrow].

name: Blank Creativity
description: Every idea begins with a blank white wall, waiting for art to bloom upon it ... Get that cat away! And don't press your hands on it!
usage: A tool that turns concepts into reality. Use it in Warehouse - Consumables to unlock new [Wondertones]. [Wondertones] can be used for remodeling islands in the Wilderness.

name: Choose-Your-Own Garment Chest
description: A fresh twist or quiet grace? Darling, each piece here waits patiently for your favor. The rustling of fabrics and distant melodies can no longer stay quiet. Don't leave them yearning.
usage: A refined, custom-made garment chest from the Goodbye to Good Night Club. Open to choose one garment from a designated collection (includes Roar Jukebox garments from Versions 1.0-2.6). If you already own every garment in this chest, it will be converted to Glowing Strand x1360 when opened.

name: Old Rain Collection Chest: UNIQUE
description: Once radiant and dazzling in your eyes—for some reason, my dear, you left it behind in your memory, to be displayed in a window.
usage: Use to select one Unique garment of your choice. If you already own all garments in this range, it converts into Crystal Drop x1,680.

name: Old Rain Collection Chest: ADVANCED
description: Once radiant and dazzling in your eyes—for some reason, my dear, you left it behind in your memory, to be displayed in a window.
usage: A figure you yearned for, lingered over, yet missed. Open to choose one ADVANCED quality garment from a designated selection. Duplicate garments will be converted to 1080 Crystal Drops.

name: Old Rain Collection Chest: GARMENT
description: Remember to pick up that nylon umbrella left at the street corner. This time, please don't rush away.
usage: A figure you pondered endlessly, examined time and again, yet missed. Open to choose one GARMENT quality garment from a designated selection. Duplicate garments will be converted to 880 Crystal Drops.

name: Garment Chest: Sincere Gratitude
description: Once radiant and dazzling in your eyes—for some reason, my dear, you left it behind in your memory, to be displayed in a window.
usage:
Use to select one garment of your choice. Duplicate garments will be converted into Crystal Drops of equivalent value. This item expires on 2027-03-03 04:59:59 (UTC+8).
Once expired, this item will be converted into [Sincere Gratitude Chest: Unique] and delivered via mail. When obtained, the [Sincere Gratitude Chest: Unique] will automatically open and convert into a random Unique Garment that you don't own within the [Garment Chest: Sincere Gratitude] selection pool. If you already own all Unique Garments, it will be converted into Crystal Drop x1,680.

categoryVi: Rương tự chọn vật phẩm (xem trước)

usage: A fog-shrouded box-style photo album. Grants a random Mineral, Star, Plant, Beast, or Spirit/Intelligence Afflatus Suitcase Impression upon acquisition. Open it to get a 6-star character of your choice.
